answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 9137 Country: India Title: Is the name Ahmad Maimoon correct? Question: Is the name Ahmad Maimoon correct? Answer ID: 9137 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1183/1183=M/1429) It is right to keep the name Ahmad Maimoon ( احمد میمون ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
